reason: The hypothesis synthesizes GPR-based uncertainty quantification, on-the-fly active learning, and Hamiltonian-reservoir replica exchange into a single adaptive workflow for fusion free energies of high-entropy alloys, a combination not proposed in any passage. It targets a specific, unresolved challenge (cost of multicomponent fusion thermodynamics) by integrating elements from separate domains (GPR for electronic structure, ML potentials for sampling, active learning for training) and defines a concrete falsification benchmark.
